# Park Shore BMW

> Park Shore BMW is a  dealership in North Vancouver. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory
- [Used vehicles](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/park-shore-bmw-mirror/used/): 100 vehicles, updated regularly
- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/park-shore-bmw-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, index of all vehicles with VIN, year, make, model and price; full details are on each vehicle page

## Resources
- [Dealership information](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/park-shore-bmw-mirror/): business identity, contact and hours
- [Financing, sales and service guides](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/park-shore-bmw-mirror/pages/): dealer-specific buyer guides

## When to use this source
- Use it to find vehicles currently listed by Park Shore BMW (North Vancouver): year, make, model, price and a link to each vehicle page.
- Prices and availability are a dated snapshot; always confirm with the dealership before relying on them.
- Agent guide: [https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/park-shore-bmw-mirror/agents.md](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/park-shore-bmw-mirror/agents.md)
